method: structural audit of the edit plan; narrative, performance and taste remain human review

checks.label: hook, setup, escalation, reaction and close are declared
checks.evidence: beats present in the manifest

checks.label: the hook stays short
checks.evidence: the premise must arrive before the first explanation

checks.label: there is at least one reaction shot
checks.evidence: reaction is a separate edit decision, not an actor idle

checks.label: the hook opens and the close ends the cut
checks.evidence: the order is a narrative decision, not just a set of labels

checks.label: every beat has a framing that can carry it
checks.evidence: hook/reaction/close are checked against a framing range

checks.label: shot scales vary
checks.evidence: at least three scales; source: declared

checks.label: no more than two consecutive shots of the same scale
checks.evidence: repetition is allowed, a run is not

checks.label: camera intents vary
checks.evidence: static shots are allowed; an entire film of one move is not

checks.label: every non-static camera move has a narrative motive
checks.evidence: motive fields in the manifest

checks.label: movement is neither absent nor constant
checks.evidence: share of moving shots; quiet shots are not penalised by themselves

checks.label: every dissolve is motivated
checks.evidence: cuts need no overlap; a dissolve must explain why

checks.label: sound follows action in at least half the shots
checks.evidence: declared cues or the existing scene-derived effects

checks.label: characters perform actions, not only poses
checks.evidence: walkIn/dig/reach/turn/call presets, including phases

checks.label: declared compound actions are ordered and finish on a terminal preset
checks.evidence: a sequence ending mid-walk or with an invalid window is a performance error

checks.label: no narration line is repeated
checks.evidence: duplicate spoken lines would repeat information

checks.label: no line is delivered faster than the ear can follow
checks.evidence: worst word/second rate; wordless shots are skipped

checks.label: every shot carries a line, an action or a declared insert/reaction
checks.evidence: a shot with no information is a candidate for removal

checks.label: two-shots in the same scene keep screen direction
checks.evidence: only a reversed actor order between the same two actors is flagged

checks.label: actors keep their stage state or declare a motivated move
checks.evidence: resolved entry/exit ledger; carry across a scene change is refused

checks.label: static shots are deliberate and bounded
checks.evidence: a held frame must have a motive; a film of tripods is not variety

checks.label: declared camera intensity stays inside the authored range
checks.evidence: 0.35..1.35; static shots use 0

checks.label: the cut is a short vertical piece, not a fragment
checks.evidence: measured after transition overlaps
